primary.name: Dark dimension coupling dark energy × dark matter
primary.overlap: TAC owns DM/DE identity. PPC is the coupling-as-patch, not the identity.
primary.source: Obied, Vafa, Bedroya, Wu 2025; WIRED 2026-09-07; DESI DR2 2025
primary.claim: DESI 2024/2025 prefers evolving (weakening) dark energy. Rather than retire Λ as the coordinate, a 2019 'dark dimension' scenario (Obied, Vafa, Bedroya, Wu 2025) absorbs both DM and DE residuals by adding an extra compact dimension whose size sets both. WIRED/Quanta coverage 2026-09-07. The pipeline (ΛCDM reduction of BAO+CMB+SNe) stays intact; the extra DOF is unobservable by construction.
primary.discriminator: Pre-register a unique dark-dimension prediction (e.g. a specific w(z) shape AND a DM coupling scale) that ΛCDM+w0wa cannot mimic. If Rubin/Euclid/Roman fit w0wa without the extra dimension, PPC holds and the patch failed as successor. If the unique prediction is confirmed, PPC is wrong — it became a successor coordinate.

penalized.name: Pop III still unseen; metal-line diagnostics as patch
penalized.overlap: Undersampling of first stars is the naive class. PPC is the candidate-threshold that lets the coordinate survive without a pristine object.
penalized.source: arXiv:2607.00167 (2026-08); ApJL 2025 metal-polluted Pop III; Siegel 2025-12
penalized.claim: No pristine Pop III stars known as of mid-2026 (Siegel; CSI Sesto 2026). JWST sees metal-polluted systems at highest z. New UV-metal diagnostics (ApJL 2025) select 'Pop III candidates' with >25% metal-free mass — a patch that keeps the Pop III coordinate without a metal-free object.
penalized.discriminator: A pre-registered 'zero metals, He II, no AGN mimic' object. If the next three years only yield mixed-mass candidates, PPC holds. One clean Pop III galaxy kills this instance.

penalized.name: ΛCDM operational default after majority-loss (physicists survey)
penalized.overlap: FAC owns Hubble-tension verdict failure. This is belief vs pipeline, not a discriminator.
penalized.claim: Afshordi, Halper, Rini, Schirber, arXiv:2605.11058 (10 May 2026), press 2026-09-08: ΛCDM failed to gain majority support among physicists surveyed. Inflation 51% (bare majority). String 19%, LQG 12%, gravity unquantized 18%. DM: 21% combination, 17% low-mass particles, 12% modified gravity. Authors: 'scientific truth is not decided by a vote.' Sample is 'physicists worldwide' — not demonstrated to be working cosmologists.
penalized.discriminator: Re-cut the survey on self-identified cosmologists only. If ΛCDM then has majority, this instance dies (population error). If it still lacks majority, measure the fraction of 2026 DESI/Euclid/Rubin papers whose headline result is reported as a ΛCDM residual. PPC holds if that fraction stays high while belief-majority stays lost.
penalized.sense: Time (who still reduces to the coordinate)

penalized.name: Milky Way IMF exported to z≳5 galaxies
penalized.overlap: Closer to Exported-Prior (iterate). Observable, so weak unobservable-DOF.
penalized.claim: JWST 'impossibly early' massive galaxies assumed a MW-like IMF. van Dokkum et al. / Nature Astronomy 2026-08-18: oldest galaxy (z_form>5) most bottom-heavy; masses may rise by ~4±1. A 2026-07-24 ApJL paper claims the crisis is a reionization degeneracy, not mass. Two patches compete to save the formation-efficiency coordinate.
penalized.discriminator: JWST Cycles 3–4 spectra of the same objects: if bottom-heavy IMF is measured, the 'crisis' was calibration export (EPC), not new physics. If IMF is MW-like and masses stay high, PPC/EPC both fail and formation physics must change.

penalized.name: Iron melting-curve geometry exported to the core
penalized.overlap: NCR owns 'named cause insufficient'. PPC only if adding C/O/Si/S is a patch that saves the iron-coordinate rather than a measurement.
penalized.source: Science/AAAS Goldschmidt report; Nature Communications 2025 (Fe-C nucleation)
penalized.claim: New-core paradox: field ≥4 Gyr, inner core often modeled ~0.5 Gyr. Goldschmidt 2026: iron melts >1000°C cooler under corelike conditions than longstanding curves. The 'pure iron, old melting curve' coordinate is patched by light elements (C ~3.8% for nucleation, Oxford 2025 Nature Communications) rather than retired.
penalized.discriminator: Independent melting-curve labs must agree on the cooler curve. If they do, the paradox was calibration export (EPC), not a new energy source. If they do not, PPC does not apply (it is FAC).

penalized.name: Kunlun hydrogen field as patch to the global abiotic H2 budget
penalized.overlap: Undersampling (more vents). PPC only on the *budget equation* that absorbs each new field as a patch term.
penalized.claim: Kunlun hydrothermal system (Science Advances 2025-08-08): estimated 4.8e11 mol/yr H2, ≥5% of global submarine abiotic hydrogen from one field. The 'diffuse, well-mixed abiotic hydrogen' coordinate is patched by adding a giant point source rather than rebuilding the inventory method. Doldrums hybrid vents (Schmidt / MBARI, reported 2026-09-08) further imply transform faults are missing terms, not extra patches.
penalized.discriminator: If a systematic transform-fault survey predicts Kunlun-class flux a priori, this is undersampling. If each new field is added post hoc to keep a pre-2015 budget form, PPC holds.

penalized.name: Early dark energy / extra neutrinos as H0 patches
penalized.overlap: FAC primary for Hubble tension. PPC only on the patch-industry, not the tension.
penalized.source: H0DN A&A April 2026; CosmoVerse White Paper 2025; Poulin EDE literature
penalized.claim: Hubble tension (local H0 73.50±0.81, H0DN 2026-04 vs Planck ~67) remains FAC. EDE, extra Neff, and similar pre-recombination patches add DOF to keep the ΛCDM pipeline. They are the industry of residue-absorbers.
penalized.discriminator: If a patch is required by independent probes (not just H0), it is a successor. If it only fits H0 and worsens S8, it is PPC.

penalized.name: Human phonetic inventory exported to sperm-whale codas
penalized.overlap: EPC iterate. Not TAC. Consciousness refused — do not smuggle sentience.
penalized.source: Project CETI; Proceedings B 2026-04; NYT 2025-11-23; Guardian 2026-04-15
penalized.claim: Project CETI 2025–2026: sperm-whale clicks described as vowels, diphthongs, rubato, ornamentation — terms from human phonology. The finding of combinatorial structure is sourced. The *labels* are an exported prior. Danger: dismissing a real homology. Scored as EPC iterate, weak PPC (the coordinate 'animal communication is not language' is being patched by importing our phonology rather than building theirs).
penalized.discriminator: Hold out a naive listener (no human-phonetic labels) + a model with whale-native features only. If combinatorial structure survives without vowel/rubato labels, the structure is real and EPC was about naming. If structure collapses, PPC/EPC holds: we patched 'not language' by importing ours.

penalized.name: Lost seafloor / stalled slab as patch to simple subduction
penalized.source: Interesting Engineering 2025 roundup; tomography literature late 2024
penalized.claim: Tomography candidate for 'lost seafloor' stalled in the mantle transition zone east of the East Pacific Rise. Each anomalous slab is added to keep the simple-subduction coordinate rather than changing how plates are allowed to founder.
penalized.discriminator: If geodynamic models predicted stall locations before the tomography, not PPC.

penalized.name: Coleoid sentience criteria exported to nautilus
penalized.overlap: Undersampling. Authors own the gap. Not a patch to save a coordinate.
penalized.claim: Schnell 2026 Biological Reviews: octopus/cuttlefish meet 6/8 sentience criteria; nautilus 1/8, and every miss is insufficient evidence, never a demonstrated fail. The coleoid coordinate is being used as the reduction target for a lineage that diverged ~500 Myr earlier.
penalized.discriminator: A nautilus-first criterion set, pre-registered, that is allowed to return 'unknown' without importing coleoid scores.

penalized.name: Placebo as residual patch on the drug-coordinate
penalized.overlap: NCR + prior art. Consciousness adjacent — do not load-bear.
penalized.source: Standard medical literature; not 2026-fresh as a class object
penalized.claim: Pharmacology's operational coordinate is molecule→receptor→effect. Placebo/nocebo residuals are absorbed as 'context effects' without retiring the coordinate. Prior art is large. Consciousness refused.
